question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a spelling error.

The conferrence / attempts to / trace the processes and / consequences of climate change.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"conferrence"** is incorrectly spelled. The correct spelling is **"conference"**. (सम्मेलन)

 
 
• **Example: **The annual science **conference **will be held in New York this year.
 
 
 
• **"Conference"** refers to a formal meeting for discussion. (सम्मेलन)
 
 
• **Example: **Experts from around the world attended the climate change **conference**.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Consequences of climate change** (जलवायु परिवर्तन के परिणाम): The outcomes or effects that result from climate change.

 
 
• **Example:** The **consequences of climate change** include rising sea levels and extreme weather events.
 
 
 
• **Attempts to** (प्रयास करता है): To make an effort to achieve or complete something.
 
 
• **Example:** He **attempts **to solve the puzzle every day.
 
 
 
• **Trace the processes and** (प्रक्रियाओं का पता लगाना और): To follow or discover the course or development of something.
 
 
• **Example:** Scientists **trace the processes and** changes in ecosystems over time.
